wholePhysicalScope: The 12-point OpenStreetMap outline fixes the approximately 57 m by 25 m cruciform shell. Schultz’s 1915 plan places the separate campanile to the southwest and shows the covered passage linking it to the church.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the church outline, transepts, nave roof, pointed portal, clustered rose lights, linked campanile and clock. Near levels add vents, grilles, hoods and clock details.
limitations: The museum exterior represents the 2007 phase on an approximate prewar reconstruction. Finish and form follow the original drawings and published material descriptions.

The exact finished tower dimensions, roof height, lantern treatment, east and north openings, and the extent of the historical terrace are estimates. The tower’s original published plan supplies its location within the grounds.
